summary: Tonto NF lookout on Colcord Mountain: 1925 and 1928 Aermotor towers, present 83-ft steel tower built after 1959 plan; NHLR-registered 1996; still standing.

facts.design: 83-ft steel tower with 14x14 CL-100 cab (present); earlier towers were 50-ft (1925) and 35-ft (1928) Aermotors

access.note: Reached by Forest Road 291 from Forest Road 512; the guide says the tower is open about May to October. No source says visitors may climb it

events.note: 50-foot Aermotor tower with a 7x7 cab erected
Second Aermotor tower, 35 feet tall with a 7x7 cab; the register says both towers were apparently operated at the same time

July 10, 1959 regional memo: bids being accepted for three lookouts to be built in fiscal 1960; memo says it should be possible to contract the Colcord tower's erection before winter, and that the Tonto should consider dismantling the old lookout when the new one is ready
Register says both older towers and a CCC ground living quarters were removed sometime after 1965
Present 83-foot steel tower built, sometime after 1965 per the register; the 1959 memo had planned a new tower for fiscal 1960, so 1965 is a placeholder year
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on November 27, 1996

resolved_conflicts.field: build date of the present tower
resolved_conflicts.explanation: The July 1959 memo planned the new tower for fiscal 1960, but the register says both older towers came down and the present tower went up sometime after 1965. The record gives both and does not choose.
The register gives 7,449 ft (2,270 m); the Discover Gila County guide gives 7,513 ft. The brief's 2270.5 m matches the register.

corrections.why: 15.2 m (50 ft) was the 1925 tower; the register describes the present tower as 83 feet, about 25.3 m

corrections.proposed: 83-ft steel tower with CL-100 cab (present); earlier towers were Aermotor
corrections.why: The register says the present tower is steel, not Aermotor

notes_for_editor: Brief height 15.2 m was the original 50-ft tower; the present tower is 83 ft (25.3 m). Staffing as_of 1996 comes from the registration text; no current staffing source was readable. Tonto NF social posts seen in search snippets credit the lookout with fire reports in 2024 and 2025, but those pages did not load, so they are not used. Waymarking and geocaching listings (search snippets only) give 1960 as the build year; neither page could be read, so 1960 is not used. Used two web searches and about five page reads.
